known_gaps: Part 2 of the correction -- whether blocked_by_containment may issue a preflight token for a T1 lane -- is written and deliberately not implemented. It is an admission change and requires explicit policy authority; presenting it as bookkeeping would be wrong. It is surfaced as an owner decision on UTV2-1842.

The misclassification this lane repairs is the mechanism behind UTV2-1842 being unable to open a lane, but Part 1 alone does not unblock it. Part 1 makes the refusal honest; it does not make it stop refusing.
